name: clustercontrol-mcp
description: Connect Claude Code to the ClusterControl MCP server (cmon-mcp) to inspect, troubleshoot and operate the database clusters ClusterControl manages.

mcp_url.title: ClusterControl MCP URL
mcp_url.description: The cmon-mcp endpoint, ending in /mcp. Keep the default when you reach the controller through an SSH tunnel; otherwise enter the https URL of your TLS reverse proxy.

mcp_token.title: ClusterControl MCP token
mcp_token.description: The bearer token configured on the controller: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN, or your own token when the server uses an identity map.
